newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $111/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $111/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were fully steady, with dressed basis mostly $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said.
Demand uniformly good. Seller usually good. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1275 lbs - 68.00; dressed basis many 110.00; some "calf feds" early 109.00; some "old crop" yearlings 111.00.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs - 68.00; dressed basis many 110.00; some "calf feds " early 109.00; few "old crop" yearlings 111.00. Sales confirmed - 14,000 For the week - 19,000
